clue.text: Periods of duty done by guards

parts.note: watches are the spells of duty kept on board a ship or by sentries
something done or finished is over

explanation.surface: A description of the shifts worked by sentries on guard duty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'guards' looks like the people doing the duty, but it is a verb defining the answer; 'by' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To guard someone is to keep protective watch over them, a phrasal-verb synonym.

clue.text: A revolutionary pain

parts.note: Che Guevara is the crossword's stock revolutionary

explanation.surface: A rebel who is a real nuisance, a pain in the neck.
explanation.definitionFit: A persistent dull hurt is a synonym for pain.

clue.text: A sweet shade of brown

definitions.meaning: a chewy toffee-like confection made from boiled sugar
a light golden-brown colour named after burnt sugar

explanation.surface: Describing a lovely tone of brown.
explanation.definitionFit: Burnt sugar gives both a chewy confection and the light tan colour named after it.

clue.text: His victims lose heart

parts.note: the god of love shoots arrows, and those he strikes lose their hearts by falling in love

explanation.surface: Someone whose prey become discouraged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lose heart' usually means become discouraged; here it means fall in love, as Cupid's targets do.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek god of love wounds people with arrows so that they surrender their hearts to another.

clue.text: Supreme general

definitions.meaning: ... as in the ... winner, the top or supreme one
... as in taken as a whole, comprehensive

explanation.surface: A military title: the commander-in-chief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Supreme general' reads as one military rank, but the two words are separate definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both topmost (an outright champion) and comprehensive or all-inclusive.

clue.text: Some clear sounds for listeners

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Crisp, clean audio intended for an audience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' signals that the answer is part of 'clear sounds'; 'for' belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The organs of hearing are what a listener uses; 'for listeners' is a playful description.

clue.text: Hear pianola transcription for wind instrument

indicators.note: a musical transcription rearranges a piece, so the letters of these words are reworked

explanation.surface: Listen to a player-piano arrangement of a piece for a wind instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'transcription' signals the rearrangement of HEAR and PIANOLA; 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: This stringed box sounds when the breeze blows across it, so it is literally an instrument played by wind.

clue.text: Being wild, I scare other drivers

indicators.note: wild means unruly, so the letters of the following words are scrambled

explanation.surface: A reckless motorist admits frightening other road users.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Being wild' signals the rearrangement of I SCARE OTHER; 'drivers' means those who drove ancient racing chariots.
explanation.definitionFit: Charioteers drove horse-drawn chariots, so they are drivers of a historical kind.

clue.text: Sphere of the occult

parts.note: sphere reads as a field or domain, but here it is a literal glass globe used by fortune-tellers

explanation.walkthrough: 'Sphere' suggests an area of activity; it is a literal round object.
explanation.definitionFit: A fortune-teller gazes into a glass globe to see the future, so it is a mystical round object.

clue.text: This could make you afraid to go on

definitions.text: This could make you afraid to go on

parts.words: This could make you afraid to go on
parts.note: to go on reads as to continue, but here it means to walk out in front of an audience

explanation.surface: Something so daunting that it makes you want to stop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'go on' sounds like carrying on; in the theatre it means making your entrance.
explanation.definitionFit: Performers' nerves before an appearance in front of an audience can make them fear stepping out.

clue.text: Money routed for development of religious work

indicators.note: development means working something up into a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Funds diverted to fund some religious project.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for development' signals the rearrangement of MONEY and ROUTED.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the fifth book of the Old Testament, a scriptural text.

clue.text: Foreign country one's entered before

indicators.note: one being entered means it goes inside the word for before

parts.note: ere is a poetic word meaning before
the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone has been to an overseas nation previously.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is 'is': I (one) is entered into ERE (before).
explanation.definitionFit: The Irish name for Ireland, a nation foreign to a British solver.

clue.text: A real eyesore

parts.note: eyesore usually means something ugly; here it is literally a painful swelling on the eyelid

explanation.walkthrough: 'eyesore' normally means an ugly sight; read literally, it is a sore on the eye.
explanation.definitionFit: An inflamed swelling on the eyelid is quite literally a sore on the eye.

clue.text: Caught girl with nothing on with boy

parts.note: lass is a word for a girl
O looks like zero, nothing
Ed is a boy's name, short for Edward

explanation.surface: A lad grabbed a girl wearing no clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with nothing on' paints nudity; 'on' just places O after LASS.
explanation.definitionFit: A cowboy roping an animal with a looped rope has captured it.

clue.text: Gave everyone a hand

parts.note: giving a hand sounds like helping, but here it means handing out playing cards to each player

explanation.surface: Someone helped all the people around them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a hand' suggests assistance; at the card table it is the set of cards each player is given.
explanation.definitionFit: Distributing cards to every player at the table is what a card dealer did.

clue.text: Quickness of the hand is unimportant, they say

indicators.note: what people say is heard, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: slight means trivial or unimportant

explanation.surface: A remark that manual dexterity hardly matters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'they say' signals a word that sounds like SLIGHT (unimportant).
explanation.definitionFit: Conjurors' dexterity is called sleight of hand, the skill of deceiving with nimble fingers.

clue.text: Verbal authority

parts.note: authority given in words: permission granted simply by declaring it

explanation.walkthrough: 'Verbal' suggests an expert on words; it means authority granted by speaking.
explanation.definitionFit: Permission granted simply by someone declaring it is power exercised by word of mouth.

clue.text: Lawful time, back in the fifties

indicators.note: in means one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty, so two of them make fifties

indicators.note: back means the word for time is read in reverse

parts.note: an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A permitted period, harking back to the 1950s.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' reverses AGE to EGA, which goes 'in' LL.
explanation.definitionFit: Something permitted by law is a synonym for lawful.

clue.text: A mother provided for one who lacked one

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal

explanation.surface: A mother providing for somebody who was missing one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'provided for' is a link; the definition means a man who had no mother, the first human in Genesis.
explanation.definitionFit: The first man in Genesis was created directly by God, so he had no mother.

clue.text: A return of serve which is some way off

indicators.note: return means the piece for serve is turned back to front

parts.note: to serve in the armed forces, here the Royal Air Force

explanation.surface: A tennis player returns a serve that lands far away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return of' reverses RAF (the Royal Air Force, where one serves) to FAR; 'which is' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Something at a distance is remote, a synonym.

clue.text: Embrace for warrior previously decorated?

definitions.meaning: a bar added to the ribbon of a medal already won, awarded to a soldier honoured once before

explanation.surface: A hug offered to a veteran who once won medals.
explanation.walkthrough: A clasp is a bar fixed to a medal ribbon for a soldier already holding that medal.
explanation.definitionFit: A hug is a holding-tight; a bar added to an existing medal recognises a further act.

clue.text: It sees or can be seen in the dark

definitions.text: It sees or can be seen in the dark

parts.words: It sees or can be seen in the dark
parts.note: an animal's eye that sees at night, and also the reflective road stud that shines in headlights

explanation.walkthrough: A feline's eye sees in the dark; British road studs of the same name glint in headlights.
explanation.definitionFit: A feline's eye sees at night, and the reflective road stud named after it shines at night.

clue.text: Quietly withdraw and go before the others

parts.note: p is the musical abbreviation for piano, quietly
to recede is to pull back or withdraw

explanation.surface: Slip away discreetly and leave ahead of everyone else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To come ahead of something in order or time is a synonym.

clue.text: Where one lives a little in Panama, for example

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: a Panama is a type of straw hat
a bit is a little

explanation.surface: Someone describes a short spell living in Central America.
explanation.walkthrough: Panama looks like the country; it is a straw hat, with A BIT placed 'in' it.
explanation.definitionFit: A natural home or environment is where an animal or plant lives.

clue.text: Talk on about proportional representation

indicators.note: about means one piece goes around the other

parts.note: taken as written
a ratio represents a proportion

explanation.surface: A lecture concerning the electoral system called PR.
explanation.walkthrough: 'proportional representation' looks like the voting system; read literally it is a RATIO, with ON placed 'about' it.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal speech is a kind of talk.

clue.text: Depend on entirely? Not half!

indicators.note: not half means half of the word is left out, here its first four letters

explanation.surface: Asking if one can trust something completely, with an emphatic reply.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not half' is British slang for 'very much', but here drops the first half of ENTIRELY.
explanation.definitionFit: To rely on is to trust or count upon, so it means the same as depend.

clue.text: You have the right of ownership

parts.note: taken as written
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Telling someone they are entitled to own something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'have' is a link; the definition describes a possessive word.
explanation.definitionFit: A possessive pronoun expresses belonging, so the definition describes its grammatical role.

clue.text: An air of sanctity

parts.note: air reads as an aura or manner, but here it is a tune, a sacred song

explanation.walkthrough: 'air' suggests a holy demeanour; it is a tune sung in church.
explanation.definitionFit: A song of praise sung in worship is a sacred tune.

clue.text: In the morning he gives a slight cough

indicators.note: In means the word he is placed in the abbreviation for morning

parts.note: AM is the abbreviation for morning
taken as written

explanation.surface: A man clears his throat at breakfast time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gives' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the sound made by clearing the throat to attract attention.

clue.text: Skills he required to make a suit

indicators.note: the word for skills needs he to make the suit, so he is removed from the suit

parts.note: hearts is one of the four suits in a pack of cards
taken as written

explanation.surface: A tailor needs particular abilities to make clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suit' looks like clothing; it is a card suit. The answer plus HE makes HEARTS.
explanation.definitionFit: Crafts or techniques requiring skill are called arts.

clue.text: It's informal — no fee or difficulty

definitions.meaning: costing nothing and posing no difficulty, read as two words joined

explanation.surface: Something casual, with no charge and no hassle.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means relaxed and casual; literally it combines costless with effortless.
